title: Atlassian - Increased error rate in US East for Atlassian Jira, Confluence and Access customers
text:
Service: Atlassian
Incident: Increased error rate in US East for Atlassian Jira, Confluence and Access customers
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2019-07-15T15:42:29.605Z
Resolved: 2019-07-15T17:08:58.823Z
Updates:
- 2019-07-15T17:08:58.823Z: resolved - Between 14:12 UTC to 16:13 UTC, we experienced increased errors rates for Access, Confluence and Jira customers connecting to our US east API endpoints. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally.
- 2019-07-15T15:42:29.653Z: investigating - We are investigating an issue with Atlassians API Gateway in US East that is impacting some Access, Jira and Confluence Cloud customers. We will provide more details within the next hour.

incident.name: Increased error rate in US East for Atlassian Jira, Confluence and Access customers

incident_updates.body: Between 14:12 UTC to 16:13 UTC, we experienced increased errors rates for Access, Confluence and Jira customers connecting to our US east API endpoints. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally.
We are investigating an issue with Atlassians API Gateway in US East that is impacting some Access, Jira and Confluence Cloud customers. We will provide more details within the next hour.
